title: RAID REPORTS SAY WHAT HELD THE FRAME RATE
why: FPS czar: five of his raids on 10-28 ran at a steady 30 fps and the run lines could not say why (the draw passes were light, about 4 ms, but they time only the drawing). Each live raid frame now files the game own work, and every run line prints it with the screen rate and the frame cap, so the next slow raid shows whether the game or something outside it held the frame rate. Report only: nothing in play changes.
now: Each raid line in the flight recorder ends its frame numbers with work:p50/p95ms screen:Nhz cap:N, and the party run report carries the same.
